    • drawTiles

      void drawTiles(List<Position> positions, String playerName) throws InvalidParameterException
      Draws the tiles in the given positions from the livingRoom.
      Parameters:
      positions - the positions of the tiles that have to be removed from the board, where the first in the list is the first one to be inserted into the player's bookshelf, and the last one is the last one to be inserted.
      playerName - the name of the player drawing the tiles.
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if the given positions/column are/is not valid.

    • orderChosenTiles

      void orderChosenTiles(List<ItemTile> orderedTiles, String playerName) throws InvalidParameterException
      Orders the tiles drawn from the living room.
      Parameters:
      orderedTiles - the tiles taken form the board.
      playerName - the player playing.
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if the player is playing in the wrong turn and if the tiles are different from the ones taken in the draw move.

    • insertTiles

      void insertTiles(String playerName, int column) throws InvalidParameterException, FullColumnException
      Inserts the tiles taken from the board in the chosen column.
      Parameters:
      playerName - the player playing.
      column - the chose column to insert the tiles in.
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if the player is playing in the wrong turn and if the chosen column does not exist in that bookshelf.
      FullColumnException - if the selected column is not refillable.
